scenes.title: Pedestrians walk on South Eighth Street in Soulard
scenes.place: Soulard, St. Louis, Missouri, United States
scenes.description: Pedestrians walk along the sidewalk on South Eighth Street in the Soulard neighborhood of St. Louis, Missouri, around 1910.
scenes.explanation: Disposable paper coffee cups with lids only became common takeaway items in the 20th century and did not exist at a 1910 sidewalk.

source.originalTitle: File:Pedestrians walk on South Eighth Street in Soulard.jpg
source.description:
Horizontal, black and white photograph pedestrians walking the sidewalk. Brick buildings line the sidewalk and a man leans against a wooden fence.
Title: Pedestrians walk on South Eighth Street in Soulard.

source.description: Market restaurant and street, Tepec, Mexico, ca.1900 Photograph of market restaurant and street, Tepec, Mexico, ca.1900. A dozen or more people, most wearing sombreros and ponchos, are standing on the sidewalk, the dirt road, or sitting in the open air restaurant. The building has a tile roof, and a small sign can be seen extending from the building to the right. To the left of the building, a small road can be seen.
